item.title: Version 0.1.3
item.description:
ContextFS 0.1.3

Homebrew now lives in the shared derek-x-wang/tap. ContextFS moved off its own per-project tap (derek-x-wang/ctxfs) into the consolidated tap that serves all of Derek's tools, so a single brew tap covers everything.

What's new

  • Single shared Homebrew tap. The cask and CLI formula are now published to github.com/Derek-X-Wang/homebrew-tap (standard Casks/ + Formula/ layout) instead of the standalone homebrew-ctxfs tap. The release pipeline pushes contextfs.rb directly to the tap's main, matching how the other tools on that tap publish.
  • No functional changes to the app or CLI. This is an infrastructure / distribution release; the binary and ContextFS.app are unchanged from 0.1.2 apart from the version bump.

Install

Mac app (recommended):

brew install --cask derek-x-wang/tap/contextfs

CLI only:

brew install derek-x-wang/tap/contextfs

Already tapped the old derek-x-wang/ctxfs?

Re-point to the shared tap once:

brew untap derek-x-wang/ctxfs
brew tap derek-x-wang/tap

Existing installs keep working and update normally over Sparkle; the tap change only affects fresh brew install / brew upgrade resolution.

Requirements

  • macOS 26.0 or later (FSKit backend)
  • macOS 15.4 or later (NFS backend fallback)
  • Apple Silicon or Intel Mac

item.title: Version 0.1.2
item.description:
ContextFS 0.1.2

Release-pipeline dry run — validates three fixes shipped between v0.1.1 and v0.1.2:

What's new

  • Sparkle version compare uses CFBundleVersion. <sparkle:version> in the appcast is now the build number (e.g. 242), not the marketing string. Previously the comparator parsed 0.1.1 as [0,1,1] and the installed CFBundleVersion=240 as [240], then refused to install. Future updates compare correctly.
  • Update dialog renders Markdown as HTML. Release notes are now rendered via pandoc in CI (gfm → html5) before going into the appcast. The Sparkle dialog shows headings, lists, code blocks, and bold instead of one wall of raw # and ** characters.
  • Cleaner appcast description encoding. Removed the manual xml.sax.saxutils.escape() from append-appcast-item.py, fixing the double-escape that produced <…> artefacts in the published feed.

If this dialog renders cleanly with formatted headings, code blocks, and bullets — the pipeline is healthy.

Install

Mac app (recommended):

brew install --cask Derek-X-Wang/ctxfs/contextfs

CLI only:

brew install Derek-X-Wang/ctxfs/contextfs

Requirements

  • macOS 26.0 or later (FSKit backend)
  • macOS 15.4 or later (NFS backend fallback)
  • Apple Silicon or Intel Mac

item.title: Version 0.1.1
item.description:
ContextFS 0.1.1

Patch release — adds the running app version to the menu-bar popover.

What's new

  • Menu-bar version label. The popover now shows v<version> (or v<version> (<build>) when build differs) next to the "ContextFS" header. Easier to confirm which version you're running and to verify Sparkle auto-updates have applied.

Install

Mac app (recommended):

brew install --cask Derek-X-Wang/ctxfs/contextfs

CLI only:

brew install Derek-X-Wang/ctxfs/contextfs

Already installed via the cask? The app's Sparkle updater will offer 0.1.1 the next time it polls, or click Check for Updates… from the menu-bar popover.

Requirements

  • macOS 26.0 or later (FSKit backend)
  • macOS 15.4 or later (NFS backend fallback)
  • Apple Silicon or Intel Mac

item.title: Version 0.1.0
item.description:
# ContextFS 0.1.0
First public release of ContextFS — a read-only, mountable filesystem for cloning-free access to Git repos, npm packages, PyPI packages, and crates.io crates.
## Install
**Mac app (recommended for most users)** — bundles the CLI and the menu-bar companion:
```bash brew install --cask Derek-X-Wang/ctxfs/contextfs ```
**CLI only (headless / CI)** — no Mac app, no menu bar:
```bash brew install Derek-X-Wang/ctxfs/contextfs ```
The cask and formula can't be installed side-by-side — the cask already ships the CLI bundled inside the app, on `$PATH`.
Or download the DMG / tarball directly from the [GitHub Releases page](https://github.com/Derek-X-Wang/ctxfs/releases).
## Requirements
- macOS 26.0 or later (FSKit backend) - macOS 15.4 or later (NFS backend fallback) - Apple Silicon or Intel Mac
## What's in the box
- `ctxfs` CLI — mount, list, unmount, diag, update - `ContextFS.app` — menu bar companion, onboarding wizard, preferences window - FSKit extension (macOS 26+) — no sudo, no Full Disk Access required - NFS v3 loopback fallback for older macOS
## Known limitations
- macOS only (Linux CLI is Phase 3.5) - Extension binary changes require a reboot (Apple FSKit constraint) - Read-only mounts only — write support is post-1.0
## Getting help
- Docs: https://github.com/Derek-X-Wang/ctxfs/blob/main/README.md - Issues: https://github.com/Derek-X-Wang/ctxfs/issues
